searchConfiguration.name: Direct use of getSystemService(String / Class) is prohibited
searchConfiguration.description:
Do not call getSystemService(String) or getSystemService(Class) directly. Use the reified extension function from androidx.core.content instead: context.getSystemService<T>()
Example: // Bad val wm = context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager val am = context.getSystemService(AudioManager::class.java)
// Good val wm = context.getSystemService<WindowManager>() val am = context.getSystemService<AudioManager>()
If direct use is truly necessary, suppress this inspection with @Suppress("DirectGetSystemService") and leave a comment explaining why.
searchConfiguration.problemDescriptor: Don't call getSystemService(String / Class) directly. Use getSystemService<T>() instead.

Direct use of View.visibility is prohibited
searchConfiguration.description:
Do not assign to View.visibility directly, either via the property (view.visibility = ..., visibility = ...) or via setVisibility(...). Use the extension properties from androidx.core.view instead: isVisible, isGone, isInvisible.
Example: // Bad binding.progress.visibility = if (isLoading) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
// Good binding.progress.isVisible = isLoading
If a direct assignment is truly necessary, suppress this inspection with @Suppress("DirectViewVisibility") and leave a comment explaining why.
searchConfiguration.problemDescriptor: Don't set View.visibility directly. Use isVisible / isGone / isInvisible instead.
